description: With visual masking set so that discrimination of two figures was the same in two conditions, subjects reported being aware of the figure more often in one condition, and the only difference functional MRI showed was activity in mid-dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (Lau and Passingham 2006, as reported by Lau and Rosenthal and by Rosenthal).
limitations: Reported secondhand here. The original 2006 paper is not among the sources read. One study, and the conclusion rests on how well performance was matched.

sources.quote: This higher level of awareness was associated with activity in dorsolateral prefrontal cortex
The only difference functional MRI revealed between cases with and without conscious awareness was activation in mid-dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (PFC).
